item.title: New $2.8 million project coming to Fremont
item.description: New renovations are coming to downtown Fremont in addition to the current construction. Using almost $3 million of federal funding, the area should see improvements on sidewalks, streets and more.

item.title: Medical cannabis focus of legislative hearings; third commissioner resigns
item.description: Dr. Monica Oldenburg becomes the third commissioner to resign from Nebraska's Medical Cannabis Board as the state continues working to implement a voter-approved medical cannabis program in the state.
